name: usage-band
description: Always-visible band above the Claude Code prompt: your 5-hour limit as one big number with a run-out forecast, and your 7-day limit against an even pace. Free, local, terminal and desktop.

colorMode.title: Color mode
colorMode.description: level: each limit turns green, amber or red with its percentage. fixed: each limit keeps its own color.
